verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs directly describe the exact workflow: invoices dragged in are auto-matched to POs, auto-coded to GL, routed for approval, and paid, with dedicated AI agents for coding, approval routing, and payment execution. This is corroborated by ERP sync and categorization details, though evidence is entirely vendor-sourced with no independent hands-on validation of AP-specific matching accuracy. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of invoice-to-PO matching accuracy and edge-case handling.
